d.title: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo Returns
d.en: The File of Young Kindaichi Returns
d.jp: 金田一少年の事件簿R【リターンズ】
d.synopsis: High school student Hajime Kindaichi is the supposed grandson of famous private detective Kosuke Kindaichi. Visiting Hong Kong for a fashion event with Kindaichi, our hero's girlfriend Miyuki is captured by a stranger in a case of mistaken identity. The journey to save Miyuki itself leads to yet another crime case...

rel.name: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo Returns 2nd Season
